What people in tech are paying attention to.
A new open model claims to match the big labs at a fraction of the cost
The company says its model reaches similar scores on common tests while using far less computing power. Researchers are impressed, but many want to see independent results first.

Researchers argue we can’t check how these models reason
A widely shared essay says today’s tools for inspecting models won’t keep up.
